# Public/installable mp1 headers, one path per line.
#
# This is the single source for the header self-containment target and for
# ci/CMake checks.  Every *.hpp under mp1/ must be listed and every listed
# file must exist; a new header therefore fails configure until it is added.
#
# mp1/version.hpp is generated by CMake from mp1/version.hpp.in and is
# deliberately not listed; the header self-containment target appends the
# generated header explicitly.
#
# The topology/cartesian/graph/distributed-graph/neighbor/grid headers are
# removed from the 1.0 surface and are not listed; the umbrella matches.
